epoch_rule: B average kl>0.05 sets epochs2 from nextupdate, stays2
metrics: KL k3=ratio-1-logratio, clipfraction and entropy averaged over valid PPO decisions across all ranks and epoch visits; imitation NLL and clipped PPO loss each averaged over their own valid samples; original total policy loss averages all rows
migration: Both groups independently load original model/optimizer/PPO and Torch RNG. A retains32 collector lanes; B retains32 includingpaths,pendingselectedactions,rewards and RNG then appends224empty lanes. Evaluation uses independent256lane collector with same perrank search seed2729+rank; training collector and Torch RNG preserved separately.
selection: Claude selects by averagefloor gain over sharedbaseline; retain both finalcheckpoints for continuation
validation: No extra experiment or testjob; native game sources unchanged, existing compiled backend retained
